disqualifier.note: Independent client feature flags; docs and the decode example write mixed true/false pairs, and the UI filters assign vs reopen independently. All 4 combinations are legal.

Independent SQL column attributes. Combinators patch each flag separately (primaryKey(), unique(), version(), default*()); identity/autoIncrement set primaryKey+hasDefault together as a convenience, but PK-without-default and default-without-PK remain legal. Readers apply flags independently (notNull/primaryKey/unique/default). All 16 combos are representable; no exclusive-write or exclusive-read among the four bits.
